shortDescription: Manage NFS exports on a PowerScale Storage System

options.name: access_zone
options.description: Specifies the zone in which the export is valid. Access zone once set cannot be changed.

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: api_user
options.description: username of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: block_size
options.description: Specifies the block size returned by the NFS statfs procedure (size dict).

options.name: can_set_time
options.description: True if the client can set file times through the NFS set attribute request.

options.name: client_state
options.description: Defines whether the clients can access the NFS export. Value C(present-in-export) indicates that the clients can access the NFS export. Value C(absent-in-export) indicates that the client cannot access the NFS export. Required when adding or removing access of clients from the export. While removing clients, only the specified clients will be removed from the export, others will remain as is.

options.name: clients
options.description: Specifies the clients to the export. The type of access to clients in this list is determined by the I(read_only) parameter. This list can be changed anytime during the lifetime of the NFS export. I(client_state) is not provided, then the host machine will replicate the values provided in the I(clients).

options.name: commit_asynchronous
options.description: True if NFS commit requests execute asynchronously.

options.name: description
options.description: Optional description field for the NFS export. Can be modified by passing a new value.

options.name: directory_transfer_size
options.description: Specifies the preferred size for directory read operations (size dict).

options.name: encoding
options.description: Encoding type for filenames returned to clients.

options.name: file_name_max_size
options.description: Specifies the reported maximum length of a file name (size dict).

options.name: ignore_unresolvable_hosts
options.description: Does not present an error condition on unresolvable hosts when creating or modifying an export.

options.name: map_failure
options.description: Specifies the user/group mapping to apply after a failed auth attempt for this export.

options.name: map_lookup_uid
options.description: True if incoming user IDs (UIDs) are mapped to users in the OneFS user database. When set to False, incoming UIDs are applied directly to file operations.

options.name: map_non_root
options.description: Specifies the users and groups to which non-root and root clients are mapped.

options.name: map_root
options.description: Specifies the users and groups to which non-root and root clients are mapped.

options.name: max_file_size
options.description: Specifies the maximum file size for any file accessed from the export (size dict).

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: path
options.description: Specifies the filesystem path. It is the absolute path for System access zone and it is relative if using non-system access zone. For example, if your access zone is 'Ansible' and it has a base path '/ifs/ansible' and the path specified is '/user1', then the effective path would be '/ifs/ansible/user1'. If your access zone is System, and you have 'directory1' in the access zone, the path provided should be '/ifs/directory1'. The directory on the path must exist - the NFS module will not create t

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: read_only
options.description: Specifies whether the export is read-only or read-write. This parameter only has effect on the 'clients' list and not the other three types of clients. This setting can be modified any time. If it is not set at the time of creation, the export will be of type read/write.

options.name: read_only_clients
options.description: Specifies the clients with read-only access to the export, even when the export is read/write. This list can be changed anytime during the lifetime of the NFS export. I(client_state) is not provided, then the host machine will replicate the values provided in the I(read_only_clients).

options.name: read_transfer_max_size
options.description: Specifies the maximum buffer size that clients should use on NFS read requests (size dict).

options.name: read_transfer_multiple
options.description: Specifies the preferred multiple size for NFS read requests (size dict).

options.name: read_transfer_size
options.description: Specifies the preferred size for NFS read requests (size dict).

options.name: read_write_clients
options.description: Specifies the clients with both read and write access to the export, even when the export is set to read-only. This list can be changed anytime during the lifetime of the NFS export. I(client_state) is not provided, then the host machine will replicate the values provided in the I(read_write_clients).

options.name: readdirplus
options.description: True if 'readdirplus' requests are enabled. Enabling this property might improve network performance and is only available for NFSv3.

options.name: return_32bit_file_ids
options.description: Limits the size of file identifiers returned by NFSv3+ to 32-bit values (may require remount).

options.name: root_clients
options.description: Specifies the clients with root access to the export. This list can be changed anytime during the lifetime of the NFS export. I(client_state) is not provided, then the host machine will replicate the values provided in the I(root_clients).

options.name: security_flavors
options.description: Specifies the authentication types that are supported for this export.

options.name: setattr_asynchronous
options.description: True if set attribute operations execute asynchronously.

options.name: state
options.description: Defines whether the NFS export should exist or not. Value C(present) indicates that the NFS export should exist in system. Value C(absent) indicates that the NFS export should not exist in system.

options.name: sub_directories_mountable
options.description: C(true) if all directories under the specified paths are mountable. If not set, sub-directories will not be mountable. This setting can be modified any time.

options.name: symlinks
options.description: True if symlinks are supported.

options.name: time_delta
options.description: Time delta object expressing time skew; expects a dict with time_value and time_unit.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: write_datasync_action
options.description: Specifies the synchronization type for datasync action.

options.name: write_datasync_reply
options.description: Specifies the synchronization type for datasync reply.

options.name: write_filesync_action
options.description: Specifies the synchronization type for filesync action.

options.name: write_filesync_reply
options.description: Specifies the synchronization type for filesync reply.

options.name: write_transfer_max_size
options.description: Specifies the maximum buffer size that clients should use on NFS write requests (size dict).

options.name: write_transfer_multiple
options.description: Specifies the preferred multiple size for NFS write requests (size dict).

options.name: write_transfer_size
options.description: Specifies the preferred multiple size for NFS write requests (size dict).

options.name: write_unstable_action
options.description: Specifies the synchronization type for unstable action.

options.name: write_unstable_reply
options.description: Specifies the synchronization type for unstable reply.
